views.name: Step 1
views.caption: Begin the controller with the controller board. Press a Nano Board into H1 and H2, its USB socket at the end of the board marked USB.

views.name: Step 1c
views.caption: Begin the controller with the controller board. Press a Nano Board into H1 and H2, its USB socket at the end of the board marked USB.

views.name: Step 2
views.caption: Press a radio module into the socket marked NRF24L01, so that the module lies over the board, away from the USB end.

views.name: Step 2c
views.caption: Press a radio module into the socket marked NRF24L01, so that the module lies over the board, away from the USB end.

views.name: Step 3
views.caption: Set the left joystick into its pocket, then push it towards L-JS until its pins are all the way into the socket.
views.caution: Make sure the joystick's pins go into the top row of L-JS, not the bottom row.

views.name: Step 3c
views.caption: Set the left joystick into its pocket, then push it towards L-JS until its pins are all the way into the socket.
views.caution: Make sure the joystick's pins go into the top row of L-JS, not the bottom row.

views.name: Step 4
views.caption: Set the right joystick into its pocket, then push it towards R-JS until its pins are all the way into the socket.
views.caution: Make sure the joystick's pins go into the top row of R-JS, not the bottom row.

views.name: Step 4c
views.caption: Set the right joystick into its pocket, then push it towards R-JS until its pins are all the way into the socket.
views.caution: Make sure the joystick's pins go into the top row of R-JS, not the bottom row.

views.name: Step 5
views.caption: Begin the car's electronics with the I/O module. Press the other Nano Board into it, its USB socket at the same end as the power socket.

views.name: Step 5c
views.caption: Begin the car's electronics with the I/O module. Press the other Nano Board into it, its USB socket at the same end as the power socket.

views.name: Step 6
views.caption: Press the adapter board onto the I/O module, its sockets over the pins along the side, with U3 at the end away from the power socket.

views.name: Step 6c
views.caption: Press the adapter board onto the I/O module, its sockets over the pins along the side, with U3 at the end away from the power socket.

views.name: Step 7
views.caption: Press the other radio module into U3, so that it sticks out past the end of the I/O module.

views.name: Step 7c
views.caption: Press the other radio module into U3, so that it sticks out past the end of the I/O module.

views.name: Step 8
views.caption: Plug the left wheel motor into LWh for the test. Remember brown to G, red to V, and orange to S.
views.caution: Very important: the brown wire goes on G, the pin on the same side as the left wheel.

views.name: Step 8c
views.caption: Plug the left wheel motor into LWh for the test. Remember brown to G, red to V, and orange to S.
views.caution: Very important: the brown wire goes on G, the pin on the same side as the left wheel.

views.name: Step 9
views.caption: Plug the right wheel motor into RWh for the test. Remember brown to G, red to V, and orange to S.

views.name: Step 9c
views.caption: Plug the right wheel motor into RWh for the test. Remember brown to G, red to V, and orange to S.

views.name: Step 10
views.caption: Snap the 9V adapter onto the 9V battery.

views.name: Step 10c
views.caption: Snap the 9V adapter onto the 9V battery.

views.name: Step 11
views.caption: Plug the 9V adapter's barrel plug into the power socket on the I/O module.

views.name: Step 11c
views.caption: Plug the 9V adapter's barrel plug into the power socket on the I/O module.

views.name: Step 12
views.caption: Connect the USB cable to the controller's Nano Board.

views.name: Step 12c
views.caption: Connect the USB cable to the controller's Nano Board.

views.name: Step 13
views.caption:
Testing Checklist
Go through the following checklist to make sure you have tested each part of your RCC:
•  The controller was powered on by connecting a Mini-USB cable to its Nano.
•  The car was powered on by plugging in the 9V battery.
•  Pushing the left joystick forward made the left wheel turn.
•  Pushing the right joystick forward made the right wheel turn.
•  Each wheel stopped when its joystick was released.
•  The battery was unplugged and the Mini-USB cable disconnected after testing.

views.name: Step 14
views.caption: Unplug the 9V adapter from the power socket, and set the battery aside with the 9V adapter still on it.

views.name: Step 14c
views.caption: Unplug the 9V adapter from the power socket, and set the battery aside with the 9V adapter still on it.

views.name: Step 15
views.caption: Unplug both wheel motors from the adapter board.
views.caution: Set the controller, the battery, the wheel motors and the I/O module aside for now. You will use them again in a bit.

views.name: Step 15c
views.caption: Unplug both wheel motors from the adapter board.
views.caution: Set the controller, the battery, the wheel motors and the I/O module aside for now. You will use them again in a bit.

views.name: Step 16
views.caption: Begin the car with L1, engraved side down. Hook the end of L2 over the notch at the flat end of L1, then swing L2 down so its tabs go into the slots in L1.

views.name: Step 16c
views.caption: Begin the car with L1, engraved side down. Hook the end of L2 over the notch at the flat end of L1, then swing L2 down so its tabs go into the slots in L1.

views.name: Step 17
views.caption: Push L3 onto L2 so its two tabs go into the short slots in L1.

views.name: Step 17c
views.caption: Push L3 onto L2 so its two tabs go into the short slots in L1.

views.name: Step 18
views.caption: Push the right wheel motor into one end of L5, its mounting tab through the slot, its wheel outwards and its wire pointing away from L5.

views.name: Step 18c
views.caption: Push the right wheel motor into one end of L5, its mounting tab through the slot, its wheel outwards and its wire pointing away from L5.

views.name: Step 19
views.caption: Push the left wheel motor into the other end of L5 the same way.

views.name: Step 19c
views.caption: Push the left wheel motor into the other end of L5 the same way.

views.name: Step 20
views.caption: Pass each motor's plug through the hole at its end of L4, then slide L4 along the wires onto the motors.

views.name: Step 20c
views.caption: Pass each motor's plug through the hole at its end of L4, then slide L4 along the wires onto the motors.

views.name: Step 21
views.caption: Turn the car the right way up. Lower L4 and L5, with the motors, onto L1: their tabs go into the slots in L1 and over L2, and each motor's wire into the notch behind it.

views.name: Step 21c
views.caption: Turn the car the right way up. Lower L4 and L5, with the motors, onto L1: their tabs go into the slots in L1 and over L2, and each motor's wire into the notch behind it.

views.name: Step 22
views.caption: Slide the I/O module, with everything on it, into the grooves in L5 and L4 from the front of the car, until it stops against L2.

views.name: Step 22c
views.caption: Slide the I/O module, with everything on it, into the grooves in L5 and L4 from the front of the car, until it stops against L2.

views.name: Step 23
views.caption: Turn the car over. Slide L7 in from the front, through the slots in L5 and L4, on the left wheel's side of L2.

views.name: Step 23c
views.caption: Turn the car over. Slide L7 in from the front, through the slots in L5 and L4, on the left wheel's side of L2.

views.name: Step 24
views.caption: Slide L6 in the same way, on the right wheel's side of L2.

views.name: Step 24c
views.caption: Slide L6 in the same way, on the right wheel's side of L2.

views.name: Step 25
views.caption: Turn the car the right way up. Reconnect the left wheel motor to LWh. Remember brown to G, red to V, and orange to S.
views.caution: Very important: the brown wire goes on G, the pin on the same side as the left wheel.

views.name: Step 25c
views.caption: Turn the car the right way up. Reconnect the left wheel motor to LWh. Remember brown to G, red to V, and orange to S.
views.caution: Very important: the brown wire goes on G, the pin on the same side as the left wheel.

views.name: Step 26
views.caption: Reconnect the right wheel motor to RWh. Remember brown to G, red to V, and orange to S.

views.name: Step 26c
views.caption: Reconnect the right wheel motor to RWh. Remember brown to G, red to V, and orange to S.

views.name: Step 27
views.caption: Push the 9V battery, clip at the top, down through the square hole in L1 into L3.

views.name: Step 27c
views.caption: Push the 9V battery, clip at the top, down through the square hole in L1 into L3.

views.name: Step 28
views.caption: Plug the 9V adapter's barrel plug into the power socket on the I/O module.

views.name: Step 28c
views.caption: Plug the 9V adapter's barrel plug into the power socket on the I/O module.

views.name: Step 29
views.caption: Connect the USB cable to the controller's Nano Board.

views.name: Step 29c
views.caption: Connect the USB cable to the controller's Nano Board.
